description: Render a click-driving YOUTUBE / Shorts / Instagram THUMBNAIL or video cover through the full production pipeline (concept, casting, scene, render, tweaks, text), not a bare image prompt. Use it for any "thumbnail", "video cover" or MrBeast-style packaging ask INSTEAD of generate_image. Default: 4 variants at 1K (YouTube shows 1280x720 at most), each billed; 2K or 4K only when the user asks. dryRun:true prices it free. The headline overlay is free. WHO IS IN FRAME — never assume or silently substitute a stranger. A framework with a person and no face photo is refused (nothing charged): ask the user once — themselves (a face photo, identity-locked), a generated person (`castGenericPerson:true`), or a people-free framework. TEXT — default is a CLEAN render with the headline TYPESET over it (free, legible, correctly spelled): pass `headline`. `bakeText:true` only on an explicit ask for words painted INTO the image. ALWAYS check the returned postRenderCheck against the image before presenting it. Full rules: get_instructions({topic:'make_thumbnail'}).

background.description: override the default bold saturated colour-field background

bakeText.description: default false. true paints the headline INTO the generation — only on an explicit user ask; it leaks garbled text elsewhere in the frame

bakedUiText.description: short label for a text-carrying framework (a chat bubble, a DAY N badge, a news lower-third, a map callout) — needs frameworkRequested:true

castGenericPerson.description: pass true only after the user has explicitly chosen a generated stranger over their own face

emotion.description: the expression on the face (default 'shock') — shock · hype · fear · confusion · determination · smug · charisma · disgust · awe · rage · laugh, or your own phrase

emotions.description: render one variant per emotion (variants = emotions × takes, max 16)

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

faceImages.description: up to 3 face photos (URLs or local paths) — each becomes a locked CHARACTER identity, in order

font.description: headline font: Anton (default) or any Google Fonts family

forceGenerate.description: render the 'screenshot' framework anyway (it is normally a real video frame, not a generation)

framework.description: concept framework id (default 'posed_portrait') — before_after · social_ui · three_step · screenshot · posed_portrait · posed_action · specific_day · graphical · landscape · map_aerial · product · adding_text · repetition · size_difference · news_clip · amplified_reality — or your own concept in words

frameworkRequested.description: true ONLY when the USER named this framework — it is what authorizes a text-carrying framework (social_ui / news_clip / specific_day / map_aerial) to bake its short UI label

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

headline.description: 2–4 word headline. Typeset OVER the finished render by default (free, always legible); newlines split it into stacked lines

headlineLines.description: explicit headline lines (up to 3) — overrides splitting `headline` on newlines

headlinePlace.description: bottom (default), top, center, or a 0-1 fraction from the top; never over the face

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

keyElements.description: signature props / effects that make it pop — oversized, flying toward camera

location.description: place, time of day, weather, atmosphere

logo.description: a brand logo URL or path to place into the composition

logo3d.description: first turn the flat logo into a volumetric 3D render (one extra billed image), then composite that

logoPlacement.description: overlay (exact, flat) | in_scene (the real file printed onto a blank panel in the shot; with logo3d, a 3D render of it, checked); auto: in_scene with logo3d

overlayStyle.description: headline style: beast (default), fire, neon-lime, clean-glass, marker, or your own CSS declarations

people.description: people described in prose instead of by photo (each still gets the chosen expression)

describe.description: the person's appearance in English prose, used instead of a face photo

reference.description: fields YOU extracted by eye from a reference thumbnail. Extract ALL of: brief (one dense sentence on the concept), subject (pose/action generically, NEVER a specific identity), elements, location, composition, background, split (boolean), split_count, person_count (0-3), emotion (one of the 11 presets or 'other'), emotion_detail (one vivid sentence covering eyes, brows, mouth, head angle). emotion + emotion_detail carry the reference's actual facial performance, which is the single biggest CTR lever on a face; split/split_count reproduce its panel structure. The reference image itself is never sent to the model

resolution.description: size; default 1K; 2K or 4K only when asked (each costs more)

restrainedGrade.description: true for a calm / premium / muted look instead of the default punchy poster grade

rimColor.description: colored back+hair light — ONLY when the user names one: 'ice-blue' / 'neon-magenta' / 'toxic-lime' / 'amber-gold' / 'pure-white'

sceneBrief.description: what the thumbnail depicts — the concept in one dense sentence, rendered exactly

sourceImage.description: the finished thumbnail URL a `tweak` edits; tweaks chain, so feed each accepted output into the next

split.description: split/panel LAYOUT — only when the user asks for one ("split", "before/after", "versus screen"). "X vs Y" as a SCENE stays one unified frame

mode.description: layout: plain, before_after, versus or custom

panels.description: panel descriptions in order, left to right or top to bottom; sets the panel count (minimum 2)

takes.description: camera takes per emotion, 1–4: designed framing / low-angle hero / extreme close-up / wide dutch tilt

topic.description: the video's topic — used to pick the hero object when you don't name keyElements

tweak.description: surgical pixel-faithful edit of a FINISHED thumbnail (needs sourceImage): kind emotion / background / background_color / rim_light, or any other kind with the edit in words as value

kind.description: emotion, background, background_color or rim_light, or another kind with the edit in words

value.description: new value for the kind: an emotion, a colour, or the edit in words

variants.description: how many to render (default 4, max 16), each billed; 1 for a single one
